issues.title: [finding] Sync misses closed epics
issues.description: Symptom: index missing 83 of 104 epics. Cause: bd list called without --all/--type epic. Body carries the real evidence, not the title.

issues.title: [decision] Incremental indexing replaces full sync on /land
issues.description: Decision: incremental sync on land; full sync only for repair. Rationale lives in the description body, which the title omits entirely.

issues.title: [action] Wire post-land indexing hook
issues.description: Steps: add tool_result hook; index successful bd remember by key; surface failures. Evidence and acceptance recorded in body.
